population: Future fixed-window publicly indexed eligible game release observations with original publication and first price histories; no complete 2026 input sample
unit: One original game project ID with first public release date, initial offer and its current observation status, not a build, developer or paid order
period: Official API/feed/indexing docs checked October 27 2026; intended fixed UTC cohort window declared by researcher
sample_frame: Official new-games RSS/newness API feature descriptions and unsynchronized paid 7/30-day public browse filter snapshots; no original release/price history export

classification_method.new_positive_price_game: First public game project release inside the fixed window, documentary proof that it had a mandatory positive minimum price at initial public launch
classification_method.new_free_game: First public game project release inside window with verified zero minimum
classification_method.old_game_updated: New observation/build/update of a project initially published before this window
classification_method.existing_free_converted_to_paid: Positive minimum introduced on an older public game, not a new project
classification_method.unverified: Missing first-public timestamp or initial price/rights evidence, not counted as confirmed first-time commercial release
classification_method.duplicate: Repeat sightings of same project ID do not increment project count
classification_method.imported_non_game: Game assets, jams, DLC, bundles, devlogs and tools are excluded from independent new game page count

valid_input_policies: All dates must be UTC and lie inside ordered declared comparison windows.
One project ID per fixed-window cohort snapshot.
History proof must distinguish new publication from later content edits and paid-price conversions.
No interpolation from a rolling last-7-day page result to 7 daily first-time paid game launches.
No game catalog feed first sighting automatically becomes a unique paid game/seller count.
limitations: RSS gives current items but not full historical original-price and first-publication proof.
The public browse Paid filter includes paid DLC, time-varying offers and updated builds; an older project may appear as recently updated.
External periodic first-sighting feeds include free games and unindexed or repeatedly appearing pages; do not call them paid launches.
A validated algorithm applied to zero authorized underlying observations is a research method, not a measured result.
